headlines.headline: SENSEX, NIFTY50 recover after weak open amid global selloff; JSW Steel, Tata Steel among top losers
headlines.summary: Indian equities witnessed a negative start on Friday, November 20, as selling pressure from Asia, elevated fixed income yields, and volatile geopolitical sentiment kept the investors in check. Here are key factors behind today's fall.

headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers, Nov 19: Maruti Suzuki soars nearly 8%, Eicher Motors surges 5%, TCS falls 2%; check list
headlines.summary: On November 19, the SENSEX jumped by 989.94 points or 1.21% to end at 83,021.75. Meanwhile, the NIFTY50 advanced by 286.35 points or 1.14% to close at its intraday high level of 25,514.30.

headlines.headline: Market wrap, Nov 19: Indices erase Middle East war losses; NIFTY50, SENSEX hit 9-month highs, Maruti Suzuki leads gain
headlines.summary: The market capitalisation of NSE-listed firms stood at ₹506.80 lakh crore at the close of the session, adding ₹5.25 lakh crore from the previous session. BSE-listed companies mcap stood at ₹5.12 lakh crore.

headlines.headline: NIFTY Bank at record high: Index crosses 63,000 mark for the first time; here's what's driving rally
headlines.summary: The strong performance of the lenders comes amid continued investor interest in the PSU banking space.

headlines.headline: Indian rupee at 7-month high against US dollar: How a stronger rupee impacts TCS, Infosys and other IT companies' earnings
headlines.summary: The rupee closed at seven month high against the US dollar at ₹93.41 per dollar on November 18, the strongest level since April, 2026. Rise in Indian Rupee could pose a challenge for TCS, Infosys and other export-oriented IT companies. Here’s a detailed breakdown.

headlines.headline: Indices volatile in early trade, NIFTY50 trades above 25,200; Maruti, Eicher Motors rally, IT stocks, Eternal slip
headlines.summary: In a pre-market note, an analyst said that weak global cues and the hawkish tone of the Federal Reserve minutes could weigh on investor sentiment, while softer crude prices and resilience in domestic banking stocks may help cushion the downside.

headlines.headline: PSBs net profit rises 16.9% in April-Sep to record ₹1.10 lakh crore, business crosses ₹300 lakh cr
headlines.summary: The aggregate operating profit of PSBs rose 13.9% year-on-year to ₹1.81 lakh crore during the April-September period of FY27.

headlines.headline: The comeback club: ICICI Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Bajaj Finance and Adani Port recovered up to 50% from their 52-week lows. What changed?
headlines.summary: Banking and Financial services names havee witnessed a sharp rally from their 52-week lows, primarily due to their robust earnings growth and valuation comfort at lower levels. In addition, all of these four stocks witnessed strong institutional activity in the last few quarters, delivering more than 30% returns

headlines.headline: L&T shares jump 14% in a month; what’s next for the stock? CLSA flags execution pickup, strong order inflows
headlines.summary: The Group’s consolidated order book as of September 30, 2026, was at ₹853,514 crore, reflecting a 15% growth over March 2026.

headlines.headline: PSU banks dominate top gainers in NIFTY Dividend Opportunities 50 index; PNB shares jump 29%
headlines.summary: NSE data show that the index has gained 4.30% over the past 30 days. However, individual constituents have significantly outperformed the benchmark, with Punjab National Bank (PNB) emerging as the biggest gainer, surging nearly 29% during the period.

headlines.headline: Reliance, Hindustan Zinc and other metal stocks shine in Q2FY27 earnings; while auto sector faces pressure: Check key highlights
headlines.summary: The Q2FY27 earnings season which started in October 2026 served as one of key factors behind the broad-based market recovery. Q2 earnings performance was heavily mixed across sectors. Metals, oil and gas, and IT rebounded sharply, while Automobile sector posted lower profits due to soaring raw material costs.

headlines.headline: Market wrap, Nov 17: NIFTY50 ends at 25,387, SENSEX closes 427 pts higher as banking stocks power gains; check factors
headlines.summary: The benchmark stock indices ended higher on Tuesday, November 17, due to the sustained momentum from FIIs buying Indian equities amid a sharp pullback in crude oil prices.

headlines.headline: NIFTY briefly crosses 25,500, SENSEX gains over 400 pts; Senco Gold, InduInd, TCS among buzzing stocks
headlines.summary: Aether Industries shares rose as much as 3.8% to hit an intraday high of ₹1,693.90 apiece on the NSE on Tuesday, as it entered into a facility development and supply agreement with Baker Petrolite LLC, a Baker Hughes company.

headlines.headline: Banking stocks power market rally: NIFTY Bank jumps over 800 points to record high; PNB, SBI lead
headlines.summary: The rally comes amid sustained outperformance this month, with NSE data showing that the index has surged over 10.7% in the past 30 days.

headlines.headline: Market wrap, Nov 16: SENSEX rises 512 pts, NIFTY50 ends at 25,291 led by FMCG stocks; Max Healthcare top gainer
headlines.summary: The broader market, however, underperformed the main equity benchmark indices, with the NIFTY Midcap 100 falling 0.51% while the NIFTY Smallcap 100 declined 1.1%.
